config.witchersbestiary.title: Witcher's Bestiary — Settings
config.witchersbestiary.enabled.tip: Scales only wild hostile WB monsters. Pets, peaceful NPCs and fist fighters are excluded.
config.witchersbestiary.live: Server settings. Live; health updates within 1 second.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveDayIn:
Complete Overworld calendar days between stages.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s. Interval must be a whole number.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveHealt:
Increase from base health per stage, without compounding. Recalculation never heals wounds.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveDamag:
Increase from base damage per stage, limited by the maximum damage multiplier.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveArmor:
Percentage points of armor-point bypass per stage. Enchantments and armor toughness remain intact.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveNorma:
Scaled health cap for ordinary monsters. Original base health is never reduced.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveElite:
Scaled health cap for bosses in the existing progressiveElites list. Base health is not reduced.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveDamag:
Upper damage multiplier. 1 means no additional damage.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s.
config.witchersbestiary.progressiveArmor:
Maximum armor-point bypass. Pets, peaceful NPCs and fist fighters are excluded.
Range: %s–%s. Default: %s.
